description.value: Man Ri Sung is a traditional Korean restaurant located inside Aberdeen Centre mall in Richmond, originally established in 2007 in Port Coquitlam before relocating to its current larger space. The menu centers on classic Korean dishes — soups, BBQ, and the house specialty Beijing duck — an unusual pairing that sets it apart from typical Korean restaurants. Korean soju and beer are also served, making it a solid option for a sit-down post-ride meal in the Richmond cycling corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (8 spaces) at 24m; rack at 45m; rack at 74m. Total: 8 spaces.
